schema_validation_policy.schema_version_control: Each consuming dataset must be bound to the schema_id and source_version in this manifest; schema revisions require explicit manifest change.
schema_validation_policy.format_support: Only extensions declared in MATLAB/project_config.json are supported. No automatic parser fallback.

xlsx.sheet_names: required_sheets when declared; exact names only; no guessed sheet/header.
xlsx.headers: Prompt 19 input_validation.m must enforce field names and required columns from the relevant schema.
xlsx.formulas: Formula cells and cached values must be treated explicitly. Formula presence alone is not an evaluated engineering result.

csv.headers: One explicit header row; unique field names; required columns and units must match schema.

json.top_level: Object unless a schema explicitly declares another root type. Validate required keys, types and schema version.

semantic_checks: Units and basis are explicit; convert only through a controlled unit registry.
Missing/null distinct from numeric zero; status/provenance must accompany unknown or assumed data.
Duplicate primary IDs rejected within their declared scope.
Numeric ranges, physical bounds and correlation validity intervals enforced without extrapolation.
Component, reaction, stream, equipment, utility, scenario and KPI foreign keys resolve.
Elemental balance A*nu=0; reaction rank/dependent columns and extent feasibility checked.
Complete compositions sum to unity on a declared basis; incomplete compositions are not normalised.
Every process datum is traceable to source IDs, record/page/figure, units, provenance class and approval/status.
Source file hash and manifest/schema versions verified before data are accepted.
schema_validation_policy.implementation_gate: Prompt 19: input_validation.m implements file-specific headers, units, missing-value, duplicate, range, ID, composition and provenance checks. Prompt 18 startup validates project/config/manifest, paths, declared formats, file existence and SHA-256 only.

notes: Prompt 1 G1 requirements approval remains awaiting user review. G2 route approval is not evidenced. G3 is not frozen.
Route C is a working academic configuration only. The 50 t/day Prompt 17 fixture is an ideal stoichiometric reference, not plant capacity or solved flowsheet.
Prompt 7 stream states for 55 conceptual streams remain null unless individually sourced/validated. Null is not zero.
Physical recycle/purge, plant-wide balances, validated EOS/VLE, kinetics, vendor maps, utilities, equipment sizing, economics and plant exergy remain blocked.
